# The two-section broadband Wilkinson (MWPD, N = 2, an octave about 2.4 GHz): seven pins. Resistor 1 (242 ohm) goes
# on R2-R3 at the outputs, wired; resistor 2 (98 ohm) is dropped straight on R2_2-R3_2, where the ring meets the
# second section. Each 0402 lands across the gap at its own junction with no line, and the ports sit on the
# divider's own pins.
